title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00093 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:15: Evaluated situation. Discussed situation w/ onshore organisation.
01:15 - 02:15: Correlated across interval 2250 mmd and 2400 mmd Positioned cutter at 2400 m. Activated cutter. WHP before/after cut 5 5 bar. DHPG read stable pressure before after cut. No indication of cutter firing. Re-attempted to fire several times.
02:15 - 02:30: Checked surface equipment, OK.
02:30 - 03:30: POOH with cutter toolstring into lubricator.
03:30 - 07:00: Closed and inflow tested SV to 345 bar/10min. B/o QTS. L/o cutter toolstring on rig floor. Insptected same. Cutter had not fired.
07:00 - 07:30: Performed TBT and handover for running new cutter
07:30 - 08:00: Performed muster drill. Meanwhile performed table top excercise on well control.
08:00 - 08:15: Performed TBT for handling explosives. Isolated TDS.
08:15 - 09:15: M/u BHA for run Leak tested lubricator/qts to 20/345 bar 5/10 min.
09:15 - 11:00: Opened SV and RIH with cutter to 2400m. Average running speed 40 m/min. Correlated depth and cut tubing at 2400m. Positive indications of cut on XT gauge and a-annulus gauge. Lost connection with DHPG.
11:00 - 11:15: Flowchecked well, static.
11:15 - 12:30: POOH with cutter into lubricator. Meanwhile tested BOP
12:30 - 13:00: Closed and inflow tested SV to 345bar/10min.
13:00 - 13:15: Performed TBT for handling explosives.
13:15 - 14:00: B/o QTS. L/o cutter toolstring on rig floor. Insptected same. Detonation confirmed.
14:00 - 14:15: Performed TBT for circulating via choke and poor boy gasser.
14:15 - 15:30: Lined up, pumped in kill wing and took returns through a-annulus outlet via poor boy degasser to slops pit. Applied 20 bar on stand pipe, opened kill wing. No pressure drop observed. Corrected and confirmed line-up.
15:30 - 17:30: Staged up mud pumps to 1300lpm/83bar. Circulated 1 x b/u. Stopped pumps due to h2s alarm on one portable gas detector in shaker room Continued circulating additional b/u at 1300lpm/83bar.
17:30 - 19:15: Prepared and checked

sections.text: Evaluated situation. Discussed situation w/ onshore organisation.

Correlated across interval 2250 mmd and 2400 mmd Positioned cutter at 2400 m. Activated cutter. WHP before/after cut 5 5 bar. DHPG read stable pressure before after cut. No indication of cutter firing. Re-attempted to fire several times.
Checked surface equipment, OK.
POOH with cutter toolstring into lubricator.
Closed and inflow tested SV to 345 bar/10min. B/o QTS. L/o cutter toolstring on rig floor. Insptected same. Cutter had not fired.
Performed TBT and handover for running new cutter
Performed muster drill. Meanwhile performed table top excercise on well control.
Performed TBT for handling explosives. Isolated TDS.
M/u BHA for run Leak tested lubricator/qts to 20/345 bar 5/10 min.

Opened SV and RIH with cutter to 2400m. Average running speed 40 m/min. Correlated depth and cut tubing at 2400m. Positive indications of cut on XT gauge and a-annulus gauge. Lost connection with DHPG.
Flowchecked well, static.
POOH with cutter into lubricator. Meanwhile tested BOP
Closed and inflow tested SV to 345bar/10min.
Performed TBT for handling explosives.
B/o QTS. L/o cutter toolstring on rig floor. Insptected same. Detonation confirmed.
Performed TBT for circulating via choke and poor boy gasser.

Lined up, pumped in kill wing and took returns through a-annulus outlet via poor boy degasser to slops pit. Applied 20 bar on stand pipe, opened kill wing. No pressure drop observed. Corrected and confirmed line-up.
Staged up mud pumps to 1300lpm/83bar. Circulated 1 x b/u. Stopped pumps due to h2s alarm on one portable gas detector in shaker room Continued circulating additional b/u at 1300lpm/83bar.
Prepared and checked toolstring. M/u BHA for 7" me plug. Leak tested lubricator/qts to 345bar/10min. Opened HMV and MMV. Read pressure on XT cross and opened SV.
RIH me plug to 249m. Average running speed 40 m/min.
Correlated depth and set me plug at 249m packer element). Tagged top of plug.
POOH into lubricator Average pulling speed 40 m/min. Closed SV and HMV. Inflow tested SV to 185bar/10min.
Performed TBT prior to b/o QTS.
B/o QTS. L/d and inspected toolstring.
Lined up and inflow tested me plug to 280bar differential pressure for 10min by pressuring up through AWV. Bled off pressure to closed drain.
Performed TBT prior to r/d wireline equipment
R/d wireline lubricator hoses and riser. Meanwhile pressure tested drilling BOP
R/d wireline BOP and lower WL riser.
